hero.title: Welcome to Stonker!
hero.subtitle: Simple, fast, and clear tracker for stocks and crypto. Keep your entire portfolio under control – earnings, deposits, rates, and overviews in just a few clicks.
hero.cardIncomes: Stock and crypto earnings by day, month, and quarter
hero.cardTransactions: Record of deposits/withdrawals and currency conversions

features.title: What can Stonker do?
features.earnings: Quick comparison of performance by day / month / quarter. Color visualization of growth and declines.
features.portfolio: One place for both asset classes. Current prices, currency conversions, and aggregation.
features.transactions: Overview of deposits/withdrawals and currency changes. Clear trail for correct profit evaluation.
features.security: Two-factor authentication (2FA), persistent login, and activity audit logs.
features.simplicity: No unnecessary complexity. Clear tables, filters, and exports.
features.privacy: Your account, your data. Manage your account and security anytime.

steps.title: How to start in 3 steps
steps.createAccount: Create an account and enable 2FA for higher security.
steps.addAssets: Add assets, deposits, and history will be filled from available sources.
steps.trackProgress: Track progress over time and make data-driven decisions.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.installQ: Do I need to install anything?
faq.installA: No. Stonker runs on the server. Just sign in via your browser.
faq.dataA: We use persistent token login, optional 2FA, and access audit logging. Sensitive actions are recorded.
faq.currenciesA: Yes. The app tracks currency rates and allows conversions and evaluation in your preferred currency.
faq.exportA: Yes, you can export via DataTables to CSV/XLSX or PDF as needed.
